latin: Sicut non omne corpus, sed perfectum anima participat, ita non omnis anima sed perfecta intellectu participat; omnia tamen uno participant.
translation: As it is not every body but the perfected one that shares in soul, so it is not every soul but the perfected one that shares in intellect; yet all things share in the one.
translation_note: 'perfectum' and 'perfecta' are taken as 'the perfected' body and soul. No further crux.
